rules: NEVER use generic fonts like Inter, Roboto for headings.
Enable tabular-nums globally for numbers, especially in the receipt preview.
Keep text high contrast (WCAG AA compliant).

colors.archetype: Swiss & High-Contrast mixed with Soft Utility
rules: Use CSS variables for theming to easily toggle light/dark.
Do NOT use generic gradients. Keep colors flat and functional.
Ensure all text has at least a 4.5:1 contrast ratio.
Primary button should have clear active/hover states (e.g., hover:bg-blue-700 hover:text-white).

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid border (light/dark adaptive). Do not use soft muddy shadows.
visual_enhancers.radii: rounded-xl for cards, rounded-full for pills/floating buttons.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimalist ambient shadow (shadow-sm) for cards, slightly elevated (shadow-md) for floating bottom bars.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 (light) or bg-slate-900/80 (dark) ONLY for sticky headers or floating bottom docks, ensuring text is perfectly readable. NEVER use transparent backgrounds behind text.

components.input_area: Large, easily tappable input field. Must have autofocus. Pressing Enter adds the item, clears input, and maintains focus.
components.receipt_preview: Container that looks like a physical receipt. Use mono font, dashed borders (border-dashed) for dividers, right-aligned numbers. Highlight the TOTAL in a larger size.
components.row_actions: Swipe gestures if possible, or a simple ⋮ (kebab menu) triggering a small dropdown (Edit, Duplicate, Delete, Move Up/Down). Touch targets must be at least 44px.
components.bottom_action_bar: Sticky bottom dock/pill on mobile with primary actions (Save, Share, Print).
components.toast: Use a minimal toast notification (like sonner) for error handling ('Format belum dikenali') or success ('Nota disalin').

grids_and_layouts.mobile: Single column. Sticky header -> Input area -> Scrollable Receipt Preview -> Sticky Bottom Action Bar. Use generous padding (p-4 to p-6).
grids_and_layouts.desktop: Two columns. Left column: Input and Actions. Right column: Sticky Receipt Preview. Use grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-8.

rules: Add a subtle entrance animation (fade-in + slight slide-up) for new items added to the receipt.
Use micro-interactions for button press (scale down slightly, e.g., active:scale-95).
Semantic HTML tags (header, main, footer, section).
All interactive elements must have min 44x44px touch targets.
Use aria-labels for icon-only buttons (like the ⋮ menu).
Provide clear focus rings (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary) for keyboard navigation.
ALL interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

media.print_css: Include specific print styles (@media print) that hides UI elements (input, buttons, headers) and formats the receipt preview to fill the page (A4) or fit a thermal printer width (80mm). Remove backgrounds, ensure text is black.
media.icons: Use lucide-react. Simple, consistent stroke weights.
media.pwa: Ensure manifest.json is configured correctly for standalone mode.

instructions_to_main_agent.architecture: Build a React + Vite + Tailwind application. Keep it strictly client-side (IndexedDB for storage). Fast initial load. The project uses .js/.jsx files (not .tsx) as strictly requested, adapt all code to JavaScript.
instructions_to_main_agent.ux_flow: The core loop 'Open -> Type -> Enter -> Type -> Enter' MUST be frictionless. The input field must immediately regain focus after Enter.
instructions_to_main_agent.parser_logic: Implement a robust but forgiving regex/parser to extract Item Name, Quantity, and Price from a single string. (e.g., 'Beras 4x40' -> Name: Beras, Qty: 4, Price: 40). Display format must drop 'Rp' and use Indonesian thousand separators.
instructions_to_main_agent.state_management: Use lightweight state management to manage the current receipt items, history, and settings.
instructions_to_main_agent.testing_hooks: Strictly add data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='input-transaction', data-testid='add-item-btn', data-testid='receipt-total').

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Create new components that match the style and conventions of existing components when needed.
Examine existing components to understand the project's component patterns before creating new ones.
Use sonner for toasts. Sonner component are located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.jsx or .js (since TS is not used).
